title: ESTIMETR Take-off Quantities Become Re-checkable
description: เปลี่ยนปริมาณจากตัวเลขที่พิมพ์เข้าไปเป็นตัวเลขที่คำนวณได้และตรวจซ้ำได้ ทุกรายการถอดปริมาณเก็บบรรทัดวัดเป็น จำนวน × กว้าง × ยาว × หนา พร้อมค่าเผื่อที่ต้องระบุที่มา จำนวนมิติที่กรอกถูกบังคับโดยหน่วยที่เลือก และงานน้ำหนักแปลงจากความยาวด้วยตัวคูณที่มีที่มา พร้อมกันนั้นวางรอยต่อของสองชั้นราคาไว้ที่ projects.project_path ตาม ADR 0007 ก่อนเริ่มงานราคาในเวอร์ชันถัดไป
scope: record ADR 0007 for one take-off carrying two costing stacks, government implemented first
add takeoff_measurements as the child rows a take-off quantity is computed from
require the number of length dimensions the chosen unit implies, and convert mass from a length with a sourced factor
compute a take-off item quantity as the sum of its measurement lines, never as a typed-in number
record a waste percentage that refuses to apply without a stated source
multiply quantities as scaled integers and round once at the item, matching the existing sum path
add projects.project_path so a project declares the government or private costing path at creation
refuse item confirmation until at least one measurement line exists, alongside the existing evidence rule
verification: unit tests reproduce the worked footing example from the reference knowledge base for one 1.50 x 1.50 x 0.35 m footing: 0.7875 cu.m of concrete, 2.1 sq.m of formwork and 31.35528 kg of DB12 rebar with the 7% allowance, which the reference prints rounded to 0.788, 2.10 and 31.36
unit tests refuse a cubic-metre item measured with two dimensions, refuse a zero or negative dimension, and refuse a waste percentage with no stated source
unit tests confirm 0.1 x 0.2 x 0.3 stays exact through the scaled-integer path

opt-in PostgreSQL tests cover the item quantity being recomputed in the same transaction as the measurement write, a second line changing the total and its removal restoring it, the allowance keeping both the gross and net figures, refusal to confirm a quantity with no recorded arithmetic, refusal of a line whose dimension count does not match the unit stored on the item, the measurement lines locking once the quantity is confirmed, and another organization being refused on every measurement write
pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test (138 passed with the opt-in database suites enabled), pnpm build and pnpm security:check pass; migration 0002 applied to the local database
rollback: Revert the v0.17.0 commit and drop migration 0002, which is additive only: takeoff_measurements, the waste and gross-quantity columns on takeoff_items, and project_path on projects. Existing takeoff_items.quantity values are never rewritten by the migration, so take-off items created before this release keep their typed-in quantity and are shown as having no measurement lines.
constraints: The take-off tables stay free of any price, cost, profit or tax column; that separation is the whole point of ADR 0007.
Take-off items created before this release keep their typed-in quantity and are not forced to have measurement lines retroactively.
Mass units cannot be derived from geometry alone, so a mass measurement carries a conversion factor and the note that states where the factor comes from.
No pricing is introduced in this release; the workflow still stops at step three of four.
The reference knowledge base under km/ is ignored by Git: it holds licensed textbooks and official circulars that must not be published with the source.

items.title: Add structured dimension breakdown to take-off items so a quantity's arithmetic can be re-checked
Declare the government or private costing path on a project (ADR 0007)
Seed the Factor F table as a versioned dataset carrying its interest rate, source checksum and reviewer
Give price observations a unit, a material and labour split, and a condition, because the official labour schedule prices one item at several rates
Require a human verification step before any OCR-extracted price or factor can be used in a calculation
Validate the official DPT source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 before claiming export compliance
Apply GitHub branch protection once the plan upgrade allows it
Run the opt-in PostgreSQL suites in CI so the row lock, entitlement and trial-clock guarantees are machine-checked instead of hand-verified
Enforce capabilities.read on every ESTIMETR read path so the platform kill switch stops reads, not only writes
Enable the pre-commit hook on every clone and run the quality gate on feature branches
Extend check-roadmap to compare the pointer with its versioned file, the package version and the handoff it claims
Enforce the waste percentage stated source with a database CHECK, not only in the application layer
Order organization selection deterministically before a member can belong to more than one organization
